rule_outs: Dwelling 5 m from the best section
summary: Short, very steep kerb on Moggill Road beside apartments and a loading zone.
reasons: Grade about 27%, far over the limit

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks sit 5 m from the east kerb and a church and offices are close; nobody would miss a van.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 21 m of kerb on a bend with a steep bank; cars park in the bays but there is no level room beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Moggill Road, a main road, with a turn junction at the north end.
drivers.convention: Loading zone (2 min passenger, 20 min commercial) and 2P parallel signs; not an overnight spot.

sun_shade: Shrub and tree cover on the east bank; open to the west.
